scope: Authoring and review index; not additional tools or execution authorization

atomicSteps.inputAndCompletionEvidence: 标题、设备日期和时区；时间在未来且少于366天
atomicSteps.failureOrUnknownHandling: 真正缺少时间才澄清，不改为循环

atomicSteps.inputAndCompletionEvidence: 仅Sela自己的闹钟，依据实际系统授权状态

atomicSteps.inputAndCompletionEvidence: `alarm_create` 一次，取得实际ID和计划瞬时

atomicSteps.inputAndCompletionEvidence: 用实际ID与时间核对；数字日期先辨明2001参考纪元

atomicSteps.inputAndCompletionEvidence: 宿主从同次真实回执展示大号时间、日期、标题与创建结果

atomicSteps.inputAndCompletionEvidence: 系统告警界面、SDK状态和实际声音分别核验

atomicSteps.inputAndCompletionEvidence: 用户安排、设备日期与时区；得到起止瞬时，结束晚于开始

atomicSteps.inputAndCompletionEvidence: 明确的日历名称或允许使用默认日历；目标须存在且可写

atomicSteps.inputAndCompletionEvidence: `calendar_search`；核对范围、完整标题、起止时间和所属日历

atomicSteps.failureOrUnknownHandling: 未知提交保留回执，不能自动再建

atomicSteps.inputAndCompletionEvidence: 任务要求核对或处理旧提交时，再查询准确范围与标题

atomicSteps.inputAndCompletionEvidence: 宿主从同次真实回执生成日历卡片，`finish.text` 说明结果

atomicSteps.inputAndCompletionEvidence: 用户提供的姓名；仅查询需要的对象

atomicSteps.inputAndCompletionEvidence: 实际完整、有限或拒绝权限

atomicSteps.inputAndCompletionEvidence: `contact_search`，取得真实匹配数、返回项与截断状态

atomicSteps.inputAndCompletionEvidence: 沿用本任务已核验的完整引用和保存账本

atomicSteps.inputAndCompletionEvidence: Sela前台、宿主工具和实际授权流程

atomicSteps.inputAndCompletionEvidence: 核对来源、范围、覆盖与截断；区分null和数值0

atomicSteps.inputAndCompletionEvidence: 使用本任务已保存的真实完成元数据核对数量和完整区间

atomicSteps.inputAndCompletionEvidence: Sela前台与实际系统授权流程
